name: Andrew Zisserman
bio: Andrew Zisserman is a Professor of Computer Vision Engineering at the University of Oxford and a Royal Society Research Professor, affiliated with Google DeepMind. Zisserman works on computer vision and co-wrote the textbook Multiple View Geometry in Computer Vision with Richard Hartley. Honors include Fellowship of the Royal Society and the Royal Society Milner Award.
known_for: Multiple View Geometry in Computer Vision
